AUTHORIZED: ONE additional attempt S31-4, same 200 GiB guard, wall clock 60 min, corrected pressure rule: STOP only if (a) `memory_pressure -Q` leaves the normal level (free < 15%) in two consecutive 5-s samples, or (b) Swapouts increase in three consecutive samples; compressor page counts are recorded but are NOT a stop condition. Record this ruling verbatim (miscalibration acknowledged) in the ledger. If S31-4 exceeds, the RESOURCE-BLOCKED disposition stands with no further attempts this shift; the R206 handoff then carries the gated decomposition proposal from your diagnosis as the next step.
